chapter_title_en: The Battle for the Heaven-Mending Pill
chapter_keywords: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 496: The Battle for the Heaven-Mending Pill – A Nascent Soul's Gamble
chapter_meta_description: Wan Tianming risks his physical body for the legendary Heaven-Mending Pill, only to be outplayed by Brutal Beard’s hidden Thunder Whale treasure. A stunning reversal sets the stage for a desperate chase.
og_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality – Chapter 496: The Battle for the Heaven-Mending Pill
og_description: An explosive reversal in the Void Heaven Palace as Brutal Beard counters a legendary thunder technique and claims the prize, forcing every elder into a frantic pursuit.
twitter_description: Brutal Beard’s Thunder Whale stone turns Wan Tianming’s ultimate trump card into dust. The pill changes hands in a battle of wits and rare loot.

lore_anchors.definition: The condensed spiritual core of a Nascent Soul stage cultivator. A ‘second life’ that can flee the body, but its survival is tenuous without a physical anchor.
A legendary, inherited lightning technique considered a peak trump card. Its release is devastating, but it is vulnerable to specific rare counters.
A rare mineral harvested from the body of a Thunder Whale demon beast. It naturally absorbs and neutralizes thunder-type attacks.
A high-speed movement technique unique to a disembodied Nascent Soul, allowing for short-range teleportation at a severe cost to the user’s foundational vitality.
A legendary five-colored pill capable of repairing a cultivator’s spiritual roots. It is the central prize of the Void Heaven Palace expedition.
The overarching ruling power of the Chaotic Star Sea. Both Righteous and Demonic paths view it as their primary long-term adversary.
